Warranty - Warranty periods
Brindlewick Audio headphones have a warranty period of 12 months from the delivery date. Speakers have a warranty period of 24 months. Cables, ear tips, and other accessories have a warranty period of 3 months.
</document>

<document source="data/kb/repairs.md">
Out-of-Warranty Repairs - Repair fees
Products outside their warranty period can be repaired for a flat fee. A headphone repair costs $39 and a speaker repair costs $59. The fee includes parts, labor, and return shipping.
</document>

<document source="data/kb/repairs.md">
Out-of-Warranty Repairs - Repair guarantee
Every repair comes with a 6 month guarantee on the replaced parts. If a product cannot be repaired, the repair fee is refunded in full and you receive a 20% discount code toward a replacement.
</document>

Question: How long is the warranty on speakers?
response: The warranty period on speakers is 24 months.
